pairs.subject: packaging
pairs.evidence: features/data-releases/DataReleasesPage.tsx:8 This context is a pair of Next.js web routes (a server component plus server-only store loaders), and the 'snapshot download' it offers is a data export, not an installed desktop application. I searched features/data-releases and features/atlas for installer, electron, tauri, codesign and notariz and found zero hits, so the precondition of the desktop-packaging subject (an app installed on user machines) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: features/data-releases/DataReleasesPage.tsx:8 A server-rendered web page has no installer, no install scope and no upgrade/uninstall transitions.
features/data-releases/getDataReleasesData.ts:1 Server-only loader running inside the web server process; nothing is laid down on a user machine, so there is no installed tree to accept.
features/atlas/getAtlasData.ts:2 The Atlas loader reads the store on the server and ships no native payload to a client install.
